nom: COSRX Advanced Snail Mucin Power Sheet Mask

avis.texte: Korean's absolutely know skincare!!! I have NEVER found a product from this brand that isn't absolutely amazing! It's also very reasonably priced!! Thank you for offering us such an amazing product!❤️
Super hydrating mask that works really well to plump up my skin. Very happy with this purchase and will repurchase!
This stuff saved my dry, red, itchy skin and i'm now going to buy a bottle!

avis.titre: Never had acne like this before
avis.texte: I was excited for these face masks because I love the snail mucin essence. At first i loved it it felt nice and hydrating. Then immediately after i got a HUGE breakout and I AM NOT USUALLY ACNE PRONE. I SOMETIMES get ONE pimple that goes away after a week. I have never had acne like this EVER. I had a breakout all over my face that has now been here for 2 months. I thought it was something else, but when i tried the face mask again my acne got worse, and it started the first time I used it.
These masks are easy to apply and leave my skin feeling immediatly hydrated. There's usually extra serum in the packet that can be used the next day as a treatment.
Dermacell mask by koi is better, I will finish using these, but they do smell like chemicals

avis.titre: Who Knew Snails Were More Than Just Cute
avis.texte: I absolutely love these masks. I don't have dry skin, but I absolutely love how plump and nourished my skin feels when I wake, after sleeping in one of these. Like all sheet masks, I do make a few snips here and there so it lays nicely. I put the extra serum in the package on my chest, arms and top of hands. Wonderfully hydrating, leaving me with glass skin in the morning. Definitely repurchasing.
I love this hydrating sheet mask. Its now the only one I buy. I have very dry skin and this takes care of it.

avis.titre: Good hydration but very difficult to use
avis.texte: I do like these masks for their hydration they give my skin. However, unfolding them and applying without distorting the mask is SUPER difficult. They stretch out so much in all of my attempts to use them. (I bought two boxes.)

I love these snail mucin face masks. Theyre suoer hydrating and moisturizing. They leave my skin feeling good. The masks are sticky which can make them difficult to remove from the package and apply, but the benefits of using the mask outweigh the sifficulty getting them out of the package.
Such a hydrating mask for my dry, dull, and acne prone skin. Absolutely love this brand
I love these, actually hydrates, feels like i have serum nicely soaked into my skin hours after using. not super sticky

avis.titre: The only sheet mask I care about
avis.texte: I am truly convinced these are the only sheet masks that make a difference for my skin. Yes, they're kinda messy, but I've never had another sheet mask still have my skin looking and feeling better after a day or two!!

Very disappointed that this has tea tree oil in it. I didnt check the label because i use many cosrx products and i trust them. I noticed my face burning very quickly after putting the mask on. I checked the ingredient list to find out it has tea tree oil. I dont understand why. That is such a highly sensitizing ingredient. Such a shame because my skin actually looked a looked a lot better when i took it off but my skin just felt so sensitized.
Enjoyed the mask with the weird eye holes…I wouldn't pay for this again.
This mask made my skin so irritated. Ruin my skin. I guess I'm unlucky got an allergic reaction.
My skin is very dry and sensitive. These sheet masks hydrate my skin without any irritation.

I keep coming back to these masks. I've tried a handful of Korean brand sheet masks and this one soothes my skin without any irritation. The mask is thin and saturated with serum. I do have to cut the sides so the mask fits my whole face. Since I already use snail mucin I just power any extra serum into a travel snail mucin bottle you can purchase at Ulta.

I had tried the viral collagen mask by Sungboon a few times at decreasing time durations and every time it destroyed my skin. The skin around my mouth, chin and jaw broke out in all these little bumps, I developed acne, I was dry and raw. This mask saved me. After just one use I noticed an improvement. After two uses, my skin feels mostly repaired. My skin feels so good and moisturized, I can't even express how grateful I am to this product. There's a lot of juice left in the packet after using the mask too, so I'm able to do multiple applications. No amount of moisturizer or hydrating oils were able to do what this mask did for me in two uses. It was gentle enough to not further harm my damaged skin, yet nourishing enough to repair it. The price point is reasonable too. I will be keeping this mask on hand always.

avis.titre: Too much effort for minimal results
avis.texte: This stuff is MESSY…the serum drips everywhere as soon as you take out the mask. I also have to make 5-6 cuts just to have it sit well on my face, the proportions of the mask are really strange. It is really hydrating and not irritating, helped me recover from some extreme dryness from pimple patches which im happy about. But the cost of using it…you're better off finding something else. I love the innisfree energy masks instead (and theyre cheaper!) Unless youre willing to go through all the extra steps required for these, there's plenty of other options for a fraction of the price.
My skin feels sooo amazing after using this mask! Ever since i was introduced to this brand by my brow lady i have bought multiple products, including these sheet masks & im obsessed !! Get them!!

when I first got this product it made my skin really smooth. I liked that it had no smell and it was great for my sensitive skin. After just three uses my acne and just texture overall on my face had gotten better. This is a need especially when it is paired with the essence you will literally have baby smooth skin!!!

I use a ton of face masks and these are definitely on my favs! I can't believe more people aren't talking about them! I love the essence like most people but this mask is honestly even better. Agee I use one my skin literally feels like silk and is so glowy! I just finished my first box and I'm reordering another now. These are super inexpensive compared to my other favorite masks too it's insane.

These make your face feel nice and hydrated afterwards but they are so slimy and messy! Its hard to get it all folded out because they are so slimy and because of that they also tear easily. If it werent for that they are great but its wayyyy too much slime.
Okay, it's a bit slimy but it's worth it! Love the way this makes my skin feel nourished and gives it a healthy glow. There's enough product to use on your neck too.

As an Esthatician, I love these masks! They are so hydrating and will literally make you look like a glowing glazed donut. It's very gentle and helps dry, dull, and dehydrated skin, it's even really good for acne prone skin!! Literally one of the best sheet masks out there
Very hydrating. Id recommend using at night bedire bed to give time for it to settle inti yiur skin because this mask is vey sticky but my skin looked great after.

I think the mask would've been perfect if it wasn't as much mucin in it. My face was super slimey and shiney afterwards. In my opinion, you are better off with just the bottled version. It felt good on though.
is very refreshing and makes my skin soft and hydrated. mask stays on face well too.
